rows.text: Written procedures describing the handling of all written and oral complaints regarding a drug product shall be established and followed.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To describe how written and oral complaints about a marketed product are received, recorded, assessed and closed, and when a complaint leads to an investigation.

3. Receiving a complaint

3.1 Any employee who receives a complaint passes it to QA the same working day. 3.2 QA opens a complaint record with a number, the date received, the complainant, the product name and strength, the batch number and the nature of the complaint. 3.3 Samples returned with a complaint are labelled with the complaint number and held in the QA retention cabinet.

6. Records

Complaint records are kept in the QA complaint register for one year after the expiry date of the batch concerned, and complaint trends are reviewed in the annual product review.

model.reason: The SOP establishes written procedures for receiving, recording, assessing and closing both written and oral complaints about marketed products (Purpose and Section 3), and the scope covers all complaints about tablet and capsule products released from the Chennai site, whoever receives them.

rows.text: Such procedures shall include provisions for review by the quality control unit, of any complaint involving the possible failure of a drug product to meet any of its specifications and, for such drug products, a determination as to the need for an investigation in accordance with § 211.192.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To describe how written and oral complaints about a marketed product are received, recorded, assessed and closed, and when a complaint leads to an investigation.

3. Receiving a complaint

3.1 Any employee who receives a complaint passes it to QA the same working day. 3.2 QA opens a complaint record with a number, the date received, the complainant, the product name and strength, the batch number and the nature of the complaint. 3.3 Samples returned with a complaint are labelled with the complaint number and held in the QA retention cabinet.

4. Assessment and investigation

4.1 QA decides within five working days whether the complaint is about a possible failure of the product to meet its specifications. 4.2 If it is, the batch record and the retained samples are reviewed and an investigation is opened under SOP-QA-015; other batches that may be affected are included. 4.3 QA also decides whether the complaint must be reported to the licensing authority.
